title: Linkage Atlas
subtitle: Four bars, one wandering point, and the geometry of motion.
description: A hands-on four-bar kinematics notebook with five mechanism studies, signed circle-intersection assemblies, editable link lengths, and deterministic coupler paths. Explore Grashof inversions, unreachable angles, dead centers, and an honestly approximate Chebyshev straight-line segment.
instruction: Choose a study, then drag pin B or scrub the input angle. Change the link lengths and tracer position to discover a new coupler path.
